title: Proton-coupled pseudocapacitive behavior of a manganese oxide-decorated nitrogen-rich COP for sustainable high-performance energy storage devices
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29613-29626
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04868K, Paper
Open Access

Nakul Desai, Y. N. Sudhakar, M. Selvakumar, Dheeraj Devadiga
A hierarchical hybrid material (Mn2O3@COP) with dual charge storage capabilities was created by synthesizing a triazine-based covalent organic polymer (COP) that is rich in nitrogen functionalities and integrating it with Mn2O3 nanoparticles.
